baseline.note: The commit that introduced this tool. Claim-bearing lines authored BEFORE it are not inventoried: the branch carries 180 of them across the repair report, the decision briefs and the run record, and hand-writing 180 ownership notes for historical narrative would produce a very large artefact of little value while making the allow-list itself unreviewable. Recorded as an explicit, checked-in baseline rather than left as an unstated default, because an unstated scope limit is how a check starts looking stronger than it is. Every line touched from this commit onward is inventoried, which is the whole point: the figures that go stale are the ones a change moves.
